purpose: Acquire public TRY Data Explorer directory metadata for provenance preflight and compare with pinned AusTraits source metadata on the exact 254-system discovery graph, without opening TRY trait values.
known_version_boundary: TRY website main database reports v7, but public Explorer advertises v6.0/2022-10-13; public directory is not certified to contain all TRY v7 primary sources or current access rights.
fields: AusTraits dataset metadata primary DOI (if recoverable)
Lexical dataset name similarity used ONLY to flag possible overlap, never establish independence
no_outcomes: No TRY individual trait values are requested or opened.
No K, rho, trait ranks or named-trait signed outcomes are inspected.
Never use TRY v6 directory counts as TRY v7 species-family sample support.
Do not infer external validation independence from absence of title or DOI matches.
No relaxation of 10 families x 20 species, four of five traits, or >=10 families with two traits.
Closed BIEN 201-system rho core remains closed.
